## Brandon Mathis’ Post

📣❗️ Today marks the beginning of a new journey for me. I am leaving the world of independent contracting to join on as Engineering Lead at [This Dot](https://www.linkedin.com/company/thisdotlabs?trk=public_post-text)! Helping businesses build technology products and expand their engineering capabilities has always been my greatest passion. At This Dot, I will be able to work with more teams than ever! If you want to learn more about what the future holds for me or are looking to partner with me and my new team, send a DM 💡
